spec._label: Gate 2.6 follow-up: the main matrix showed Hall of Fame peaking in years 5-15 (critic generation 1). combo_D front-loads the same 12% critic ceiling (first new generation +8%, then capped at 12%) to target that peak without being harsher late than combo_B. control and combo_B are rerun in a separate process as a reproducibility check (must match the main run exactly). TEST ASSUMPTIONS.
